name: @lacspace/keypool
description: AI key pooling two ways. createAiChain: route-ordered multi-provider failover (Gemini, Groq, Cerebras, OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, any OpenAI-compatible) that rests key+model pairs on 429 (Gemini daily quota until Pacific midnight), quarantines rejected keys (incl. Gemini's 400 'API key not valid'), cools down after N failures, shrinks Groq max_tokens to fit TPM, regrows empty reasoning replies, JSON mode with repair, per-purpose routes and caps, a call ledger hook, and a shared store (memory or Redis). createKeypool: RPM/RPD/TPM/TPD rotation and accounting. Built on @lacspace/ai.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
